scheme_name: HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth

text_blocks.text: HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth (Key fund facts): NAV (31-08-2026): ₹237.51900. Expense ratio: 0.75%. Minimum SIP investment: ₹100. Fund size (AUM): ₹97,350.48 Cr. Riskometer Category: Very High Risk.
HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth (Exit load): Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year.
HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth (Benchmark): Fund benchmark: NIFTY Midcap 150 Total Return Index
HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth (Investment objective): The scheme seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation/income by investing predominantly in Mid-Cap companies.

HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth (Stamp duty and tax): Stamp duty and tax implication: If you redeem within one year, returns are taxed at 20%. If you redeem after one year, returns exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5%.

HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth (Fund management): Fund Manager: Chirag Setalvad. Education: Mr. Setalvad is a B. Sc and MBA from University of North Carolina.. Experience: Prior to joining HDFC AMC he has worked with New Vernon Advisory Services Ltd., HDFC AMC and ING Barings N.V.
